question: The sum of the digits of the least number which when divided by 36, 72, 80 and 88 leaves the remainders 16, 52, 60 and 68, respectively, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the common difference (k): (36 − 16) = (72 − 52) = (80 − 60) = (88 − 68) = 20.

The least number is LCM(36, 72, 80, 88) − k.

LCM(36, 72, 80, 88) = 7920.

Required Number = 7920 − 20 = 7900.

Sum of digits = 7 + 9 + 0 + 0 = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given divisors and their respective remainders:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a83eb14ffc92f0986709622b0e3491bb39263c832068c9be4e7a3d14c96884.png] 

To find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 36, 72, 80, and 88:

⇒ Prime factorisation:

⇒ 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ 72 = 2³ × 3²

⇒ 80 = 2⁴ × 5

⇒ 88 = 2³ × 11

⇒ LCM = 2⁴ × 3² × 5 × 11

⇒ LCM = 16 × 9 × 5 × 11 = 7920

⇒ The least number (N) = LCM − Common Difference

⇒ N = 7920 − 20 = 7900

⇒ Sum of digits of N = 7 + 9 + 0 + 0 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM with Constant Difference

When a number leaves remainders r₁, r₂, r₃ when divided by a, b, c such that (a−r₁) = (b−r₂) = (c−r₃) = k, the number is LCM(a, b, c) − k.

LCM with Same Remainder

If the number leaves the same remainder 'r' in each case when divided by a, b, c, then the least such number is LCM(a, b, c) + r.

Divisibility of Sum of Digits

If the sum of digits of a number is divisible by 3 or 9, then the number itself is divisible by 3 or 9 respectively.</p
